title: Redux Project Structure
description: Learn recommended folder structures and organization patterns for Redux applications.

data.text: A good project structure keeps Redux logic organized, scalable, and easy to maintain.

data.title: Folder Structure
data.code:
src/
  app/
    store.ts
  features/
    auth/
      authSlice.ts
      Login.tsx
      authAPI.ts
    todos/
      todosSlice.ts
      TodoList.tsx
      todosAPI.ts
  components/
    SharedComponent.tsx

items: Group related actions, reducer, and selectors together
Co-locate components with their Redux logic
Keep API calls close to the slice

data.title: Scalability
data.text: Feature folders scale better than type-based folders as your app grows.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Group by feature, not by type
data.takeaway: Feature folders scale Redux apps effectively.
